svg.title: koda agent architecture
svg.desc: Each turn is one LangGraph run. A router sends the request to answer, reader, investigator or the edit path. Read paths end without verification; the edit path runs an optional planner, a coder with write tools, and a verifier that judges a hash-snapshot diff plus the observed tool log, retrying once on failure. Every agent node runs the same middleware chain: step budget, permission (deny gate then approval), tool execution confined to the workspace (bubblewrap on Linux only), output redaction and trimming, and history trimming before model calls.
svg.text: Each turn is one LangGraph run. Requests go to the narrowest path; only the edit path gets write tools, and only it is verified.
